title: Lock manager with upgrades, FIFO queues and deadlock victims

cases.name: random_small_1
cases.code:
import random
def wl(seed, nres, conc, n, pc, px):
    rg = random.Random(seed)
    ops = []
    active = list(range(1, conc + 1))
    nxt = conc + 1
    for _ in range(n):
        tx = rg.choice(active)
        if rg.random() < pc:
            ops.append(('COMMIT', tx))
            active.remove(tx)
            active.append(nxt)
            nxt += 1
        else:
            ops.append(('X' if rg.random() < px else 'S', tx, 'r%d' % rg.randint(0, nres - 1)))
    return ops
result = sol.run_lock_manager(wl(11, 3, 6, 120, 0.15, 0.4))
